extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.metric: Jio ARPU growth without tariff hikes
items.quote: So, you should expect some increase in the ARPU even without any tariff increases and we spoke about this 4% to 5 % kind of number that we have been observing over the last few quarters.
items.actual: Rs 218.8, up 3.5% year on year in Q2 FY27
items.why: ARPU grew 3.5% in Q2 FY27, under the band, and the next call restated the range as 3.5% to 4.5%.
items.actual_quote: Rs.218.8 as ARPU that is a 3.5% growth year -on-year in ARPU without any tariff increases.

items.quote: Company Speaker (Ketan Mody) So, like we have announced, the target continues to kind of grow leadership in all categories and we have anyway announced the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.
items.actual: Rs 16,900 crore in H1 FY27, 1.8x a year earlier
items.why: Half-year revenue of Rs 16,900 crore is 1.8x last year; reaching the target needs roughly 40% a year from here.
items.actual_quote: For the first half, our revenue was Rs.16,900 Crores, again, 1.8 times of the last year's first half.
